about.title: The Dur Story
about.description: DUR is a luxury jewelry brand offering gold and diamond pieces with contemporary designs that blend fine craftsmanship, quiet luxury, and personal identity. We believe jewelry isn't just an accessory — it's an extension of a woman's taste, memory, and presence.
